fields.description:
## Problem

In the live prompt-eval loop (`run_eval` per dataset-bearing spec, `eval-live` job in `.github/workflows/prompt-eval.yml`), seven plan-review criterion specs fail some cases with `review result failed schema validation: 'dimension' is a required property`: plan-review-G7 (6), -ac-process-gate (2), -asserted-capability (5), -decomp-shape (2), -evidence-kind (14), -necessity (2), -no-file-impact (3) (at `REBAR_EVAL_MAX_CASES=12`, 3 epochs). It also appears on origin/main 872e7f6c3fd with Opus 4.8 / Sonnet 4.6, so it is not model-specific.

## Root cause (reproduced offline 2026-11-17, origin/main 05c6414358f)

`emits_valid_findings` is registered as `_schema_review_result` (`src/rebar/llm/evals/eval_scorers.py:425`, `:160`), which validates against the `review_result` schema via `findings.validate_result` (`src/rebar/llm/findings.py:134`); that schema requires `dimension`.

The seven specs are criterion-id specs: `_criterion_id` (`src/rebar/llm/evals/eval_solver.py:76`) resolves them, so `run_case` uses the criterion arm (`eval_solver.py:101`), which returns Pass-1 findings in the `plan_review_findings` contract shape (`finding`, `criteria`, `evidence`, ... — `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/passes.py:46` `_pass1_model`), never `dimension`. The specs describe the scorer as "validates against the plan_review_findings contract". `pass1_chunk`/`pass1_container` normalize findings first (`passes.py:284-301`, `:379-412`): `finding` is coerced with `f.get("finding", "")`, and findings with no in-set criterion are dropped.

Every other consumer of the name is also a criterion-id spec emitting the Pass-1 shape, so none needs an edit and all benefit: `evals/plan-review-gate/fixtures/eval_specs/*.eval.yaml`, `.rebar/evals/plan-review-project-*.eval.yaml` (dotted `project.*` ids), and specs generated by `src/rebar/llm/evals/fixture_emit.py`. The PASS-named specs plan-review-container/-finder/-isf-finder raise "no eval solver" today (`eval_solver.py:423`); sibling bug `knightly-salty-orangutan` routes them, and they emit the same shape.

Repro: `run_case("plan-review-G7", <G7 must-fire case>, runner=FakeRunner(findings=[{"finding": "x", "criteria": ["G7"]}]))`, then `score("emits_valid_findings", ...)` -> `passed=False, "'dimension' is a required property"`. With no findings it passes, so only fired cases were lost.

Same mismatch in `attributes_g3_vs_g4` (`_attributes_criterion`, `eval_scorers.py:287`), used only by plan-review-container: it searches `criterion`/`dimension`/`title`/`detail`, but Pass-1 container findings carry attribution in `criteria`, so a correct G3/G4 finding scores as unattributed once the container spec runs.

## Approach

Score plan-review output against the contract it is produced under, reusing the registered Pass-1 model:

1. Add `_schema_plan_review_findings` in `eval_scorers.py`. Inside the function it imports `rebar.llm.plan_review.passes` and calls `passes.register_contracts()` (idempotent, `passes.py:120`) before `contracts.response_model_for("plan_review_findings")`, so it never falls back to the review_result model (`contracts.py:38-40`). It fails when: output is not a dict; `findings` is absent or not a list; the model rejects it (pydantic message); or any finding's `finding` is empty after `strip()` (the normalized shape coerces a missing claim to `""`).
2. Register `emits_valid_findings` to it. `emits_valid_review_result` keeps `_schema_review_result` (code-quality, spec-alignment).
3. `_attributes_criterion` also credits a finding whose `criteria` list contains the case's criterion, by exact case-insensitive element match (`G3` never matches `G33`; `g3` matches `G3`). A finding listing G3 and G4 is credited to each. The existing substring match over the string keys is kept; either source credits.

No config key, env var or flag is added.

## Scope

- `src/rebar/llm/evals/eval_scorers.py` — new scorer, registry entry, attribution read.
- `tests/unit/test_eval_scorers.py` — offline tests.
- `tests/unit/test_eval.py` — the existing `run_eval` tests inject a `solve` returning review_result-shaped findings for `plan-review-finder`, so they reach `emits_valid_findings` directly; migrate them to the Pass-1 shape.

Portability: pure in-process validation. The fresh-interpreter test runs `sys.executable` with an argument list (no shell).

## Testing

Offline, no model:
- happy path, parametrized over packaged criterion-id specs listing `emits_valid_findings`; first assert the discovered set is exactly the seven above. For each, `run_case` on one must-fire case with a `FakeRunner` firing that criterion; `emits_valid_findings` passes, no message mentions `dimension`. Empty `findings` passes.
- self-registration: `subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-c", ...])` imports `eval_scorers`, removes `plan_review_findings` from the contract registry (measured: `import rebar` already imports `passes`, so it cannot be kept out of `sys.modules`), scores a hand-built Pass-1 output, and asserts it passes and that the contract is registered again.
- failure path: review_result-shaped finding (`dimension`, no `finding`), empty `finding`, non-list `findings`, non-dict output each fail.
- attribution: one end-to-end positive built through `run_case("G3", <first G3 must-fire case of the packaged container spec, which carries `children`>)` (the criterion arm routes it through `passes.pass1_container`) is credited to G3. Then direct scorer calls on hand-built `{"findings": [{"finding": "x", "criteria": [...]}]}`: `["G4"]` on a G3 case fails; `["G3","G4"]` passes on a G3 and a G4 case; `["G33"]` on G3 fails; `["g3"]` on G3 passes.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] `emits_valid_findings` validates the `plan_review_findings` contract: for each of the seven criterion-id specs a fired Pass-1 finding from the criterion arm passes, with no `'dimension'` error; checked by a parametrized test in `tests/unit/test_eval_scorers.py` (exact discovered-set assertion) that fails on origin/main 05c6414358f.
- [x] The scorer registers the contract itself (fresh-interpreter test passes with the `plan_review_findings` contract unregistered before scoring) and fails malformed output: review_result-shaped finding, empty `finding`, non-list `findings`, non-dict; checked by unit tests.
- [x] `attributes_g3_vs_g4` credits a finding's `criteria` list by exact case-insensitive element match: G3 credited, G4-only rejected on G3, `["G3","G4"]` credited on both, `G33` rejected, `g3` credited; checked by unit tests.
- [x] The migrated `tests/unit/test_eval.py` `run_eval` tests pass under the new scorer, and `emits_valid_review_result` is unchanged (existing tests pass).
- [x] `make verify` exits 0.
